scholarships.name: SHODH — Scheme of Developing High Quality Research
target_students: full-time Ph.D. researchers in recognised Gujarat universities/research institutions

eligibility.academic: Applicant must have confirmed Ph.D. admission in regular full-time mode at an eligible Gujarat institution; SC/ST/OBC-NCL/differently abled candidates receive 5% relaxation per the scheme page.
eligibility.exclusions: Applicants already receiving UGC JRF, RGDF, MADF, ICSSR, ICAR, CSIR, ICPR, ICMR, ICHR or another research scholarship are ineligible; applicant must not be earning/working.

benefits.contingency: ₹20,000 per year; official page describes total assistance of ₹4,00,000 over two years

scholarships.historical_extension_pattern: Do not infer an extension from prior years.
scholarships.notes: Official page states applications for 2026–27 opened 2026-09-01 and close 2026-10-19 at 18:00.
scholarships.date_verification_policy: Any date field is cycle-specific and must be read with date_status; null means not found/announced.
